## Meeting intelligence built into every deal

Introducing Nova, Pipedrive’s latest feature. It captures what matters before, during and after every call and keeps your CRM up to date, right inside Pipedrive.

- **Briefed before:** Nova automatically pulls deal history and previous conversations into a pre-call brief. You always know exactly where things left off and what you need to do next.
- **Focused during:** It records and transcribes your calls so you don’t have to. You stay in the conversation, and Nova takes care of the notes.
- **Updated after:** It generates a recap and drafts CRM updates you can review and approve in one click – no manual entry, no catching up.

[Try it free](https://app.pipedrive.com/nova-paywall)

[Find out more](https://www.pipedrive.com/en/nova)

Nova is included in all plans, at no additional cost.

![](https://www-cms.pipedriveassets.com/gif/Nova-feature-section.gif)

### **Easily manage leads and deals**

Organize customer data and interactions in one simple tool and act fast when opportunity strikes.

- **Customize your pipelines**

Pipedrive’s kanban-style dashboard lets you visualize your sales funnel. Adjust your pipelines to your sales process and move deals along as they progress. We’ll notify you when you need to follow up.

- **Centralize your sales data and contact history**


Import data from spreadsheets or other pipeline management software in just a few clicks. Link products or services to deals to track negotiations and see the bigger picture.

- **Add custom fields**

Shape your CRM to your business with custom fields. Capture must-have info for your sales team and automate calculations with smart formulas.

[Learn more](https://www.pipedrive.com/en/products/sales/leads)

![](https://www-cms.pipedriveassets.com/cdn-cgi/image/quality=70,format=auto/https://www-cms.pipedriveassets.com/brand-half-page-illustrations/Sales-activities-450.png)

### One space for all your sales activities

Easily track sales conversations and tasks in one tool, giving your salespeople the context they need to follow up faster.

- **Your one-stop sales inbox**

Speed up response time and never miss an opportunity again with two-way email sync. Connect up to five email accounts and keep prospects hooked with customizable templates.

- **Calendar sync and task reminders**


Manage your schedule from the comfort of your CRM. Calendar sync lets you link your business calendar to Pipedrive and reminds you of upcoming deadlines, helping you stay focused.

- **Easy call scheduling**

Streamline your sales process and use AI – get more done with less work.

Cut admin time in half and let reps focus on closing deals. Easily set up workflow automations for your team or choose from ready-made templates.

## CRM FAQs

- ### What is Pipedrive?








Pipedrive is a sales pipeline CRM designed to help small businesses manage leads, track sales activities and close more deals.

- ### How does Pipedrive work?








In a nutshell, Pipedrive enables sales teams in small businesses to:



  - Streamline processes and consolidate sales data in one unified CRM sales tool.

  - Automate follow-ups and ensure timely responses to leads.

  - Keep an eye on sales achievements and assess team performance for ongoing improvement.


- ### How to set up Pipedrive?








Setting up Pipedrive is straightforward. To get up and running with our CRM [pipeline management](https://www.pipedrive.com/en/features/pipeline-management) tool, here’s a brief guide:



  - Begin by importing existing data or building your leads database within Pipedrive’s sales CRM software. Explore our Marketplace integrations to infuse your pipeline with even more quality leads.

  - Define your sales pipeline, create active deals, synchronize your business email and calendar and start scheduling your next activities.

  - If collaboration is key, set up team access. Pipedrive offers granular permissions, allowing you to fine-tune who can view or modify your CRM data.

# 7 ways SMBs can use AI for sales and marketing

[Abílio Rodrigues](https://www.pipedrive.com/en/blog/blog-authors#ab-lio-rodrigues) Content Editor, Pipedrive

The best AI for sales and marketing provides reps and marketers with clearer signals and more time to turn prospects into buyers.

AI technology does this by automating administrative tasks like data entry, surfacing actionable insights and using machine learning to predict which deals are most likely to convert.

In this article, you’ll learn what sales and marketing AI is, where it delivers the most value and top tools to consider. You’ll discover how to build a marketing and sales strategy that aligns both teams to drive real revenue and results with AI.

## Key takeaways for AI for sales and marketing

- AI for sales and marketing helps small businesses find, engage and convert buyers faster using generative AI, machine learning and automation.

- AI can accelerate and optimize almost every sales and marketing workflow, from lead capture and scoring through to nurturing and performance analysis.

- AI works best when it aligns sales and marketing so insights from one team automatically inform the other.

- Pipedrive’s AI-driven CRM provides a suite of tools that enhance marketing and sales workflows, including AI notifications and an AI email writer.


Try Pipedrive free

## Why small businesses should use AI in sales and marketing

[Artificial intelligence](https://www.pipedrive.com/en/blog) (AI) makes small-business sales and [marketing teams](https://www.pipedrive.com/en/blog/marketing-team) more efficient and effective by automating repetitive tasks, personalizing communications and analyzing vast amounts of data.

Here’s how [small and medium-sized businesses](https://www.pipedrive.com/en/blog/smb-sales) can benefit from adopting AI across sales and marketing functions:

- **Increase productivity.** AI can automate tasks such as updating records and drafting emails that [sales professionals](https://www.pipedrive.com/en/blog/sales-professionals) and marketers spend hours on each week. Increasing productivity is the main driver of AI adoption, according to [Pipedrive’s State of AI in business report](https://www.pipedrive.com/en/crm/solutions/ai-report).

- **Boost sales and marketing results.** AI drives better outcomes for sales and marketing teams by [scoring leads](https://www.pipedrive.com/en/blog/lead-scoring), prioritizing deals and more. Gong estimates the use of AI [boosts win rates](https://www.gong.io/blog/we-measured-the-roi-of-ai-in-sales-heres-how-it-really-impacts-your-deals) by 50%.

- **Facilitate aligned,** **data-driven decision-making** **.** AI unites [sales and marketing](https://www.pipedrive.com/en/blog/sales-and-marketing) by centralizing signals from previously siloed departments. Marketing sees which campaigns generate revenue. Sales sees which prospects are most engaged.

- **Improve the** **customer experience** **.** Generative AI and chatbots help small businesses meet demand for better, personalized customer interactions. It’s the [joint-second-biggest benefit](https://www.mckinsey.com/capabilities/growth-marketing-and-sales/our-insights/an-unconstrained-future-how-generative-ai-could-reshape-b2b-sales) of gen AI for B2B selling, according to McKinsey.


Ultimately, AI helps marketers and salespeople focus more on the tasks they’re best at.

By automating administrative work, increasing data flow and highlighting key insights, the technology empowers marketers to pass along more [qualified leads](https://www.pipedrive.com/en/blog/how-to-qualify-leads). In turn, sales can focus on building meaningful [customer relationships](https://www.pipedrive.com/en/blog/customer-relations) and closing deals.

## 7 ways SMBs can use AI for sales and marketing

Here are seven AI use cases for sales and marketing that can help you unlock the above benefits.

These uses cover the full [sales funnel](https://www.pipedrive.com/en/blog/sales-funnel), from first touch to closed deal. Start with the ones that match your biggest bottlenecks rather than adopting them all at once.

### 1\. Round-the-clock lead capture

AI chatbots qualify website visitors around the clock, eliminating the need for prospects to submit a [contact form](https://www.pipedrive.com/en/features/web-forms) and wait for a reply.

Using a combination of generative AI, machine learning and predefined rules, a chatbot can greet visitors, answer common questions and book meetings.

For small businesses, AI lead capture turns out-of-hours traffic into a valuable pipeline. It also stops reps from wasting time on visitors who don’t meet their [ideal customer profiles (ICPs)](https://www.pipedrive.com/en/blog/ideal-customer-profile).

Some chatbots don’t need AI to capture prospect information and route leads to the right person. [Pipedrive’s Chatbot](https://www.pipedrive.com/en/features/lead-generation-software/chat-bot), for example, lets you create custom conversation flows to qualify leads and support customers 24/7.

**Pipedrive in action:** Pipedrive’s own sales team used the Chatbot feature to add 1,000 new leads to its Lead Inbox. By pre-qualifying leads, the team [converted 30% of trialists to new customers](https://www.pipedrive.com/en/case-studies/how-pipedrive-sales-team-uses-chatbot).

As Fabiana Barbosa, Account Executive, explains:

“Implementing Chatbot has helped us to focus on calls and demos to customers during their free trial period and also avoid losing that opportunity.”

### 2\. Lead qualification, scoring and prioritization

AI can sort through hundreds of leads and rank them based on [customer behavior](https://www.pipedrive.com/en/blog/customer-behavior), fit and intent.

Even if you have hundreds of leads in your pipelines, [sales reps](https://www.pipedrive.com/en/blog/sales-development-rep) can quickly see which prospects are worth pursuing.

It helps reps work faster and smarter, which is why recommending next-best actions is among the top uses of AI, [according to McKinsey](https://www.mckinsey.com/capabilities/growth-marketing-and-sales/our-insights/five-fundamental-truths-how-b2b-winners-keep-growing).

For example, [Pipedrive Pulse](https://www.pipedrive.com/en/blog/pipedrive-pulse) analyzes your pipeline and [sales activity](https://www.pipedrive.com/en/blog/sales-activities). It predicts which deals are the most likely to close and suggests what to do next.

![AI for sales and marketing Pipedrive Pulse](https://www-cms.pipedriveassets.com/cdn-cgi/image/quality=70,format=auto/https://www-cms.pipedriveassets.com/AI-for-sales-and-marketing-Pipedrive-Pulse.png)

So if a prospect opened your last three emails, downloaded a gated asset and closely matches your pre-defined ICP, Pulse will flag them as a high-potential deal.

Instead of wondering where to focus their attention, time-stricken SMB reps can get a prioritized list of these opportunities and clear recommendations on how to move each one forward.

### 3\. Lead data enrichment

AI enrichment tools automatically fill gaps in your lead [sales data](https://www.pipedrive.com/en/blog/sales-data) by pulling in details such as job title, company size and industry.

It’s great for sales, and AI gives reps the information they need to quickly start conversations without spending 20 minutes on LinkedIn before each call.

[Pipedrive’s Data Enrichmen](https://support.pipedrive.com/en/article/data-enrichment) t automatically fills in missing information in your [customer relationship management (CRM) system](https://www.pipedrive.com/en/crm/fundamentals/what-is-crm) at the click of a button by pulling in data from various sources, including LinkedIn and Google.

AI-powered lead enrichment also keeps your CRM cleaner over time, improving other tasks like [customer segmentation,](https://www.pipedrive.com/en/blog/types-of-customer) reporting and scoring.

### 4\. Lead nurturing and customer engagement

Generative AI reduces the time and effort it takes to create personalized marketing and sales messages that nurture and engage leads.

For example, [Pipedrive’s AI email writer](https://www.pipedrive.com/en/products/ai-crm/ai-email-writer) creates drafts based on CRM data and sales activity.

![AI for sales and marketing Pipedrive AI email writer](https://www-cms.pipedriveassets.com/cdn-cgi/image/quality=70,format=auto/https://www-cms.pipedriveassets.com/AI-for-sales-and-marketing-Pipedrive-AI-email-writer.png)

It lets reps go from a blank page to a ready-to-send email in seconds with just a single natural-language prompt.

### 5\. Marketing and sales enablement content creation

Generative AI can create first drafts of key marketing and [sales enablement](https://www.pipedrive.com/en/blog/sales-enablement) assets, such as case studies, one-pagers and battle cards, in minutes.

For example, marketers can use an AI chatbot like ChatGPT or Claude to create case study copy and an AI-powered design tool like Canva or Figma to design it.

![I for sales and marketing case study generator](https://www-cms.pipedriveassets.com/cdn-cgi/image/quality=70,format=auto/https://www-cms.pipedriveassets.com/I-for-sales-and-marketing-case-study-generator.png)

The key is to treat AI-written drafts as a starting point, not the finished article. A rep or marketer should still review, edit and tighten the content to add the human nuance necessary to close a deal.

When done well, this AI-assisted approach helps small teams without a dedicated [copywriter](https://www.pipedrive.com/en/blog/email-copywriting-techniques) produce content volumes comparable to those of much larger teams.

### 6\. Campaign performance analysis

AI-powered [reporting tools](https://www.pipedrive.com/en/blog/reporting-tools) surface patterns that time-strapped marketers may miss.

Team members can spot key trends, such as which channels drive pipeline growth, which campaigns convert and where budget is wasted.

An AI-powered platform can be especially valuable for small businesses where a single marketer may be responsible for the entire mix. Instead of building dashboards from scratch, AI can produce summaries, flag anomalies and suggest next steps.

For example, you can ask Pipedrive’s [AI Report Generator](https://www.pipedrive.com/en/products/ai-crm/ai-report-generator) to create sales performance reports in seconds from natural language prompts. Or it can tell you which channel drove the most inbound conversions in the last quarter.

![AI for sales and marketing Pipedrive reports](https://www-cms.pipedriveassets.com/cdn-cgi/image/quality=70,format=auto/https://www-cms.pipedriveassets.com/AI-for-sales-and-marketing-Pipedrive-reports.png)

If you aren’t sure which metrics to track, you can take inspiration from one of Pipedrive’s [customizable dashboard templates](https://www.pipedrive.com/en/blog/sales-dashboard-templates).

### 7\. Conversation intelligence that aligns sales and marketing

[Conversation intelligence tools](https://www.pipedrive.com/en/blog/conversational-ai) record, transcribe and analyze [sales calls](https://www.pipedrive.com/en/blog/outbound-sales-calls), then turn that data into shared insights for both sales and marketing teams.

For sales, this means coaching data, deal risk alerts and automated, accurate note-taking. Tools automatically deliver feedback to reps, allowing [sales managers](https://www.pipedrive.com/en/blog/sales-management) to focus their one-to-one efforts on the moments that matter most, rather than skimming through hours of recordings.

Conversation intelligence also accelerates [employee onboarding](https://www.pipedrive.com/en/blog/onboarding-process) by creating a library of example calls that help new reps get up to speed.

[Pipedrive’s AI email summarization](https://support.pipedrive.com/en/article/ai-email-summarization) tool supports sales reps by generating concise and actionable summaries of long email threads, like in the image below:

![AI for sales and marketing Pipedrive AI email summarization](https://www-cms.pipedriveassets.com/cdn-cgi/image/quality=90,format=auto/https://www-cms.pipedriveassets.com/AI-for-sales-and-marketing-Pipedrive-AI-email-summarization.png)

Reps get a summary of the thread, an analysis of the sentiment, a readiness-to-buy score and a suggested next step.

For marketing, conversation intelligence means real evidence of which messages resonate, which objections occur most often and which pain points buyers actually talk about. It creates a feedback loop that marketers can use to optimize future [marketing campaigns](https://www.pipedrive.com/en/blog/automated-marketing-campaign).

## The best SMB AI tools for sales and marketing

The best AI-powered tools for sales and marketing will depend on your goals and internal workflows.

Here are four worth considering across different categories.

### 1\. Pipedrive: best for integrating sales and marketing

[Pipedrive](https://www.pipedrive.com/) is an [AI-powered CRM](https://www.pipedrive.com/en/products/ai-crm) built for small businesses that want to align and empower sales and marketing departments with a suite of AI tools.

Pipedrive’s suite of AI tools is ideal for small businesses that may not have the budget to invest in five or 10 different platforms.

### 2\. Outdoo: best for conversational intelligence and coaching

[Outdoo](https://www.outdoo.ai/), previously MeetRecord, is a conversational intelligence tool that analyzes every call to help sales leaders coach reps, spot at-risk deals and surface insights for both sales and marketing.

## How to build an SMB AI strategy for sales and marketing

The best way to avoid wasting time, energy and budget on AI is to make a plan before investing in tools.

Here’s a step-by-step framework you can use to successfully implement AI in your small business.

### 1\. Audit your current workflows to spot where reps and marketers lose the most time

Start by mapping the areas where sales and marketing teams currently spend the most time on manual or administrative-heavy tasks.

Common culprits often include:

- [Data entry](https://www.pipedrive.com/en/crm/data/crm-and-data-entry)

- Content creation

- [Email follow-ups](https://www.pipedrive.com/en/blog/sales-follow-up-email-templates)

- Weekly reports

- Lead research


One mapping method is to ask sales reps and marketers to log how they spend their time for a week. Then compare the time spent to the value generated to pinpoint opportunities for AI optimization.

For example, if a sales rep spends six hours each week logging call notes, updating deal stages and tidying CRM records, those tasks are obvious candidates for AI replacement.

### 2\. Assess the risks and consider solutions

Work through the risks of adopting any AI tool and develop solutions to prevent or overcome them.

Data privacy and security are two of the most common concerns. Over one-quarter of respondents in [Pipedrive’s State of AI in business report](https://www.pipedrive.com/en/crm/solutions/ai-report) cite privacy and security as barriers to AI adoption.

Other risks include:

- Hallucinations in generated content

- Inaccurate outputs or recommendations

- A lack of team buy-in

- Alienating potential customers with over-automation


You can manage most of these risks with clear guidelines and human review.

For example, set a rule that a human must review every AI-drafted email or piece of marketing copy before it goes out.

Create an AI policy that covers which tools are approved, how [customer data](https://www.pipedrive.com/en/crm/data/customer-data-platform) can be used and where AI sits within each workflow.

A lack of team buy-in is often the biggest blocker and the one that’s hardest to overcome. Both reps and marketers may worry that AI will replace them.

Address those concerns by showing how AI removes the parts of jobs people dislike, freeing them to spend more time on work that drives results. Involve the team in the tool selection process and run training sessions during the rollout to build momentum.

### 3\. Prioritize two or three high-impact use cases to run as pilots

If you apply AI everywhere at once, you’re likely to frustrate employees and see fragmented results.

Pick one or two use cases and tie them to clear [business goals](https://www.pipedrive.com/en/blog/sales-goals), such as faster lead response times or higher win rates. It will focus your efforts and help employees to see the value of the technology.

Here are some tips on running a successful pilot program once you’ve chosen your use cases:

- **Set a fixed timeline between 30 and 90 days.** A pre-defined window creates urgency, keeps the team focused and gives you a clear point to evaluate results.

- **Define clear KPIs and success** **metrics** **before you start.** For a lead-scoring pilot, that might be conversion rate by score band or the percentage of high-priority leads that turn into opportunities.

- **Document your baseline before launch.** Otherwise, proving your ROI later becomes guesswork.


A successful pilot will build internal credibility and make it easier to expand your efforts later. Use the results to secure budget for the next phase, choose which use cases to roll out across the wider team and build a roadmap for the rest of the year.

### 4\. Choose tools that integrate with your CRM and other core tools

When choosing marketing or sales tools for your pilot projects, look for those that integrate with the platforms you already use.

Connections to your CRM are particularly important for sales and marketing teams. A standalone AI app that doesn’t sync with your CRM will create more silos, not fewer.

## AI for sales and marketing FAQs

- ### Which AI is best for sales and marketing?








The best AI tools for sales and marketing depend on the problem you’re trying to solve.



Most small businesses achieve the best results with one core tool and several specialist tools, rather than a fragmented stack.



An AI-powered CRM like Pipedrive can drive sales automation and optimization across both departments.



Small businesses should also prioritize easy-to-use tools over complicated ones. Enterprise options like Salesforce can be overwhelming to smaller businesses and increase the time it takes to see results.

- ### What is the 30% rule in AI?








The 30% rule is a guideline some teams use when adopting AI. It suggests that AI should automate around one-third of your workflow, rather than the full task, to leave room for human judgment, review and creative input.



In marketing and sales, AI could handle research or content creation, but humans still handle sales calls, demos and the overall relationship.

- ### How can small businesses start using AI for sales and marketing?








Small businesses can start using AI for sales and marketing by choosing one or two specific use cases, such as lead scoring or content creation.



They could run a short 90-day pilot program to generate data and measure success before rolling out the use case to the wider team.
